card.statement:
This construction is analogous to the usual Springer resolution $T^{*}(G/B)\cong G\times^{B}\mathfrak{n}$ which maps to $G/B$ (as the cotangent bundle) and $\mathcal{N}$ (by the Springer resolution, induced by the action of $G$ on $\mathfrak{n}$ ).
∎

There is a modular description of both $\mathrm{Gr}_{G}$ and $\mathcal{T}_{G,V}$ . The affine Grassmannian $\mathrm{Gr}_{G}$ can be thought of as the space of pairs $\{(\mathcal{P},\phi)\}$ where $\mathcal{P}$ is a principal $G$ -bundle over the formal disc and $\phi$ is a trivialization over the punctured disc, considered up to isomorphism of such pairs. The identification is given by describing the action of $G(\!(z)\!)$ on such space by multiplying the trivialization by an element of $G(\!(z)\!)$ ; this is a transitive action with stabilizer $G[\![z]\!]$ .

Similarly, the BFN Springer resolution can be described as isomorphism classes of triples $\{(\mathcal{P},\phi,s)\}$ where $s$ is a section of the associated $V$ -bundle over the formal disc. The action map $\mathcal{T}_{G,V}\to V(\!(z)\!)$ is given by using the trivialization over the punctured disc to consider $s$ as an element of $V(\!(z)\!)$ .
card.label: Remark 2.10

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
